name: What types of tile are best for flooring?

mainEntity.name: What types of tile are best for flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common tile types for flooring include ceramic, porcelain, natural stone (like marble, granite, or travertine), and luxury vinyl tile (LVT). Ceramic and porcelain are durable, water-resistant, and available in many styles, suitable for kitchens, bathrooms, and high-traffic areas. Natural stone offers a unique, luxurious look but requires more maintenance and can be more expensive. LVT provides a wood or stone aesthetic with greater resilience and comfort underfoot.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular tile types for flooring are ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, and luxury vinyl tile (LVT). Each offers different aesthetics, durability, and maintenance requirements suitable for various spaces.
